action.objective: Commit Rc5, the verified centralizing rook move in the R+B+2P vs R+2P endgame.
action.rationale: Rc5 is the only commit_ready_move. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 returned exact 407 with safety complete (no mating reply) and tactical_refutation not_found. It centralizes the rook along the 5th rank, attacking h5 and controlling c-file squares, while keeping the bishop active. Broad-search c7b7 (440) is only depth 3 and upper-bounded at depth 3; that shallower exact score is not a reliable comparison against the deeper exact 407, and Rc5 keeps the rook flexible rather than committing to b7. No refutations are stored against the opponent's likely Rxa3 reply; the rook can drop back or the bishop can reposition. Choose Rc5.
